::: {#exm-dic-bernoulli}
#### DIC for the Bernoulli model

For $r = 55$ successes in $n = 91$ trials,
$D(\prob) = -2\paren{r \log \prob + (n - r) \log(1 - \prob)}$.
We estimate $\overline{D}$ and $\bar\prob$
from 5,000 draws from the $\operatorname{Beta}(56, 37)$ posterior of [the Beta-Bernoulli example](bayesian-inference.qmd#exm-beta-bernoulli):

```{r}
#| label: dic-bernoulli
#| code-fold: false
deviance_bernoulli <- function(pi, r = 55, n = 91) {
  -2 * (r * log(pi) + (n - r) * log(1 - pi))
}
set.seed(4)
pi_draws <- stats::rbeta(5000, shape1 = 56, shape2 = 37)
d_bar <- mean(deviance_bernoulli(pi_draws))
d_at_mean <- deviance_bernoulli(mean(pi_draws))
c(
  d_bar = d_bar,
  d_at_mean = d_at_mean,
  p_d = d_bar - d_at_mean,
  dic = 2 * d_bar - d_at_mean
) |>
  round(2)
```

The model has one parameter,
and its effective number of parameters $p_D$ is close to 1.
:::
